protocol.analysis: process medians -> matched within-block effects -> session medians -> descriptive three-session range; no pooled inner-sample inference
protocol.exclusions: none; every duration retained; any execution, functional or integrity failure invalidates the whole attempt
protocol.fixture_rule: session_seed + block - 1; identical across variants within each parameter/block
protocol.order_rule: permutation index (block-1 + 2*(session-1) + parameter_index) modulo 6; parameter order rotates each block
protocol.stopping: three separately launched complete sessions; retain every failed/interrupted attempt; no effect-dependent extension

security_interpretation: Reuse accepted security evidence for exact source/normal-code identities; throughput is not a leakage test
